description: This Java source file defines the class FileResourceRepository, which extends LocalResourceRepository. It manages resource data for Android projects stored in plain files, particularly in output folders like build directories or expanded .aar directories. The class includes methods for caching, creating resource mergers, and accessing resource items by type.

classes.name: FileResourceRepository
classes.description: Manages Android resource data stored in plain files, with caching and resource merging capabilities.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached or new instance of FileResourceRepository for a given file.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of FileResourceRepository instances.

methods.name: getResourceDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory file associated with this resource repository.
